text.en: Aldosterone is regulated by the pituitary gland the same way cortisol is -- in reality, aldosterone release is controlled primarily by the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system, which responds to blood pressure and blood sodium levels, not by pituitary ACTH the way cortisol is -- this is why aldosterone and cortisol, despite coming from the same gland, can be regulated almost independently of each other.
text.et: Aldosterooni reguleerib hüpofüüs samamoodi nagu kortisooli -- tegelikult kontrollib aldosterooni vabanemist peamiselt reniin-angiotensiin-aldosterooni süsteem, mis reageerib vererõhule ja vere naatriumitasemele, mitte hüpofüüsi ACTH nagu kortisooli puhul -- see on põhjus, miks aldosterooni ja kortisooli, hoolimata pärinemisest samast näärmest, saab reguleerida peaaegu üksteisest sõltumatult.
